_doc: Public sample corpus manifest (serving-hardening P0, decision D8 as modified
by the 2026-07-30 review addendum): a deliberately REDUCED, licence-clean
reference set - NOT a full city. Two sections:
reference_artifacts - enveloped artifacts whose every non-methodology source
is gov-attribution or clean-open per scripts/nvdm-encumbrance-report.py.
These are the NVDM public reference artifacts and stay redistributable in
a cold public clone after the P2 cutover.
build_fixtures - files npm run build / npm test cannot pass without, which
are NOT provably licence-clean today (share-alike OSM inputs, or not yet
enveloped so their licence position is unrecorded). Each entry documents
the encumbrance and the decision. They are NOT part of the licence-clean
reference set; including one silently (without an entry here) fails CI.
Validated by scripts/check-sample-corpus.py: reference artifacts must stay
clean as envelopes evolve; fixtures must match their recorded status (a
fixture that becomes clean must be promoted, one that degrades to NC fails).
The sample-corpus CI job prunes the corpus to this manifest and runs
npm run build + npm test against it - coverage is proven by the build.
